I just got off of the phone with my car insurance company…. I called because my bill had increased by $80/ month…. So I wanted to know why…. She said Colorado just approved an increase to all Auto insurance due to their being a high volume of claims in our State…. (Which we all can see there are multiple accidents every f***** day just here on the western slope)…. So every driver/ family gets PENALIZED for the negligence of others!!!!??? WTH I’m literally boiling pissed over this!!!! One of the things I was looking forward to in life is my insurance going down as I got older…. Lmbo…. This Country is a joke!!!! Just wanted to pass the word onto every body!!! Happy Wednesday!!!! I just can’t believe all people are penalized for the actions of others!!!! 🤬🤬🤬🤬
So yes!!!! I’m fu****** whining!!!!!
